name: GAIB sAID
oneLiner: sAID is GAIB's staked AI Dollar vault: AID is deposited into an ERC-4626 vault tracking AI infrastructure financing NAV with a 30-day FIFO unstaking cycle.
collateral: AID staked into GAIB's ERC-4626 sAID vault; vault capital is deployed into AI infrastructure financings (GPUs, robotics, and related compute) plus a stable reserve buffer of T-bills and stablecoins for liquidity
pegMechanism: sAID is not pegged to $1; it is minted by staking AID at the staking NAV (which ignores unrealized losses, keeping the mint price stable) and redeemed through a monthly withdrawal-cohort cycle: requests submitted within a calendar month are aggregated, liquidity is sourced the following month, and funds settle on the first day of the third month at the unstaking NAV (which subtracts unrealized losses). Selling sAID on a supported DEX is the immediate-liquidity alternative.

mintAuthority.summary: sAID is GAIB's ERC-4626 strategy-vault wrapper over AID (UUPS proxy, ERC1967). Wrapper shares are minted against deposited AID only via deposit(); no privileged mint function. Upgrade authority and all admin roles (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, OPERATOR_ROLE, REWARDER_ROLE) held by a single deployer EOA (0x3885be...). Base issuance inherits the reviewed AID mint-authority profile.
